title: native2unicode
summary: Decode native byte values into Unicode text.

gpu_support.notes: No GPU form is documented. Automatically resident byte vectors gather transparently; explicit gpuArray input is rejected.

fusion.notes: Not eligible for fusion; this builtin materializes host text or logical results.

description: `native2unicode(bytes, encoding)` range-checks a numeric byte vector and decodes it to a host character vector using UTF-8 by default.

inputs.name: bytes
inputs.description: Numeric byte vector with values in the range 0 through 255.

behaviors: All eight integer classes are accepted, but every element must be exactly within 0 through 255; values are never clamped or converted through binary64.
ASCII-width decoding preserves the input row or column vector shape, and character or string input passes through unchanged.
Unsupported encoding names and explicit gpuArray inputs reject.
